inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, warning of an indefinite nationwide strike if talks fail. That workers must threaten disruption to get a long-standing agreement taken seriously says a lot about whose labor institutions value—and whose grievances they can afford to ignore. University staff deserve a fair hearing and a just agreement; the government should negotiate in good faith instead of treating workers’ collective action as the problem.
